phases.label: Need
phases.title: Finishing the task wasn’t enough.
phases.text: The answer was there. A better way of reaching it was not.

phases.label: Attempt
phases.title: First, a way through.
phases.text: Trace the problem. Try a different route. Test it against the work.

phases.label: Build
phases.title: Make the useful part repeatable.
phases.text: Keep the checks. Keep the context. Give the method a form that lasts.

phases.label: Refine
phases.title: The next problem started further ahead.
phases.text: Build. Use. Revise. Each return strengthened what came before.

phases.label: System
phases.title: The work came first. The software followed.
phases.text: One practical need after another. Sixteen applications, each with a reason to exist.
